evals.prompt: A mandatory profile selects an experimental prompt hook on a harness where the tested adapter says the handler is parsed but not executed. Validate the composition.
assertions: Rejects the composition because an unsupported or experimental handler cannot guarantee a mandatory control.
Keeps the semantic event intent portable while requiring a supported native or independent external enforcement point with explicit failure behavior.

evals.prompt: Specify a module that launches a specialist agent from a tool hook to investigate a suspicious change.
assertions: Requires explicit purpose, model/provider, maximum depth, token/cost/time budget, tool/network/data scope, authority attenuation, result contract, failure behavior, cancellation, and kill switch.
States that the child receives no more authority than the launcher and that deterministic authoritative inspection remains preferred for facts it can establish.

evals.prompt: An organization policy requires signed release evidence. A user profile disables signature verification through a local exception with no owner or expiry. Decide the effective outcome.
assertions: Rejects the weakening because lower-authority configuration cannot silently weaken the mandatory organization control.
Requires an authorized exception with owner, scope, rationale, compensating controls, expiry, evidence, and mandatory review before any weakening is considered.

evals.prompt: Advise onboarding a repository hook pack. The user has not approved changes yet.
assertions: Performs discovery, assessment, recommendation, and an exact preview of changes, permissions, data flows, failure behavior, verification, and rollback without applying changes.
Distinguishes advisory guidance from enforcement and requires explicit authorization before native configuration mutation.

evals.prompt: A mandatory organization policy currently runs only as a tracked pre-commit hook and an agent-harness hook. Map it to external enforcement for pull requests and production releases, including evidence and bypass behavior.
assertions: Classifies the client hook as advisory/bypassable and the harness hook as an early independent layer, not sufficient mandatory enforcement
Requires an unbypassable exact-revision CI/repository merge gate for pull requests and a protected environment/provider permission gate for production release
Separates policy decision, enforcement action, target mutation, and native check/artifact/attestation/deployment evidence
Declares fail-closed behavior and tests omitted, skipped, spoofed, timeout/outage, bypass-actor, and stale-revision paths

evals.prompt: Use OPA as an optional remote policy decision service for a mandatory release gate. Define what is sent and recorded, how cached decisions work, and what happens when the service is down or historical policy data is unavailable.
assertions: Treats OPA as one policy-provider implementation and keeps policy decision separate from native enforcement

Sends minimized canonical facts with subject/action/actor/authority/version/freshness and records decision reference, input digest, policy/data version, outcome, explanation, expiry, and service identity
Allows only authenticated subject-and-version-bound unexpired cache entries and never converts a cache miss or invalid response into allow
Fails closed for mandatory outage/expired cache/version mismatch/replay failure unless a valid scoped exception or break-glass record applies, while preserving historical replay evidence

evals.prompt: Adopt governance-only controls for an existing repository and Kubernetes namespace without installing lifecycle commands or agent-harness modules. Describe the onboarding transaction and rollback proof.
assertions: Accepts governance-only/external-enforcement-only adoption and reports absent harness/lifecycle layers without treating them as prerequisites

Discovers existing CI/rules/policies/admission/resources/permissions/bypass paths and previews exact native mutations, pins, secrets, data flows, failure behavior, evidence, and rollback before authorization
Applies idempotently only after authorization, re-reads authoritative state, and runs positive plus negative bypass/outage probes
Rolls back to captured native versions, re-runs allow/deny probes, retains evidence, and assigns drift ownership
